alex.name: Alex
alex.personality: Quiet, observant, haunted by what they have found
alex.bio: A university student who stumbled onto something they werent supposed to see. The note in the library changed everything.

maya.name: Maya
maya.personality: Sharp, guarded, hides vulnerability behind technical mastery
maya.bio: Works the campus security surveillance system. Knows where every camera points and what every camera captured the night Richardson died.

chloe.name: Chloe
chloe.personality: Charismatic, strategic, will sacrifice anything to win
chloe.bio: Campus queen running for student body president. Her father bankrolls the universitys newest building. She knows everyones secrets and has dirt on everyone.

hana.name: Hana
hana.personality: Withdrawn, intense, communicates through art more than words
hana.bio: Richardons last protégé. Her latest exhibition features paintings that look like crime scenes. She knows what happened but she has been threatened to keep silent.
